items.title: Nscale and Anthropic Reportedly in Talks for Another $45B Compute Deal
items.summary: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly negotiating a massive $45 billion compute deal, signaling continued intense investment in AI infrastructure.

items.title: Timestral: Mistral AI Unveils New Time-Series Foundation Models
items.summary: Mistral AI has announced 'Timestral,' a new suite of foundation models specifically designed for time-series data analysis, expanding their offerings beyond traditional LLMs.

items.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
items.summary: A new research paper introduces LiveMACE, a framework for evaluating LLM agent performance in dynamic, real-world market scenarios.

items.title: Stress-Testing Gemini 4 Argon: Building a 3D Flutter Kart Game in 15 Prompts
items.summary: A developer successfully stress-tested Google's Gemini 4 Argon by building a functional 3D Flutter Kart game with zero assets using only 15 prompts, showcasing the model's advanced capabilities.

items.title: Advancing Coding in Low-Resource Programming Languages with OpenAI
items.summary: OpenAI is making strides in improving coding assistance and capabilities for programming languages with limited available data and resources.

items.title: Mamdani Says Feds Have Abdicated on AI, Urges New Yorkers to Push Back
items.summary: Assemblymember Mamdani criticizes the federal government's inaction on AI regulation and calls on New Yorkers to advocate for stronger oversight.

items.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
items.summary: Researchers introduce Scene-Designer, an agentic system that learns design principles to autonomously generate complex 3D scenes.

items.title: Embedded AI Evaluators Won't Be an Easy Solution, Hugging Face's Policy Chief Says
items.summary: Hugging Face's policy chief warns that integrating AI evaluators directly into systems will not provide a simple fix for complex AI safety and ethics challenges.

items.title: Your Agent's Retry Bug Isn't an AI Problem, It's a Distributed-Systems Problem with an LLM on Top
items.summary: A practical article argues that many 'AI agent' issues, particularly retry bugs, stem from underlying distributed systems challenges rather than inherent LLM limitations.

items.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
items.summary: A new research paper proposes 'MT Forcing' to achieve more stable and consistent results in multi-turn image editing using autoregressive diffusion models.

items.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
items.summary: Researchers present a method for creating self-evolving coding agents that improve their performance through harness-policy optimization.

items.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
items.summary: A technical report details the architecture and performance of Xiaomi-Lens-0, likely a new vision or multimodal AI model from Xiaomi.

items.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
items.summary: OpenVLHarness introduces a framework for visual agentic systems to perform real-world tool-use tasks, enhanced by multimodal memory capabilities.

items.title: I Built an AWS Agent That Scores Any GitHub Repo Before You Clone It
items.summary: A developer shares a practical application of AI agents by creating an AWS-based tool that evaluates and scores GitHub repositories to inform users before cloning.

items.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
items.summary: OR-License proposes a new benchmark to assess the ability of LLM agents to function effectively as practitioners in complex operations research scenarios.
